name: holocron
description: GPU music visualization engine that is also the music player
$licence-note: Holocron is GPL-3.0-or-later (D-010), so GPL dependencies are compatible. What is NOT acceptable is anything non-redistributable: --enable-nonfree FFmpeg stays excluded under any licence. libprojectM at M4 must stay dynamically linked through its C API to keep the LGPL boundary intact (D-012), so it may not simply be added here.
$ffmpeg-note: default-features is FALSE deliberately, and the feature list is explicit. The port's 'gpl' and 'nonfree' features are not in its defaults today, but relying on that is relying on an upstream default we do not control - and 'nonfree' produces libraries that are unredistributable under ANY licence, which would be unfixable after the fact. Listing features also drops avdevice, avfilter and swscale, none of which an audio decoder uses.

$dependency-notes.pocketfft: BSD-3-Clause, header-only. FFT for the analysis stage (#9). The implementation SciPy uses. FFTW was available under D-010 but rejected: a 2048-point real FFT at 93.75 Hz does not justify the weight.
$dependency-notes.libebur128: MIT. ITU-R BS.1770-4 loudness for AudioFrame::loudness_short (#9, D-024). Hand-rolling the K-weighting filter and gating would produce a number that looks plausible and is not comparable across tracks, which would destroy the only reason D-007 leaves the field un-normalized.
$dependency-notes.catch2: BSL-1.0, GPL-compatible. Test-only, hence the feature.
